items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Now, I had a very good boss. Michelle was a very reasonable man. He'd give and take.

ctx.x: I used to play them numbers. I used to play them numbers like that, going behind all the

man and go to town with them. I mean, all I like that I play. I used to play them numbers like that. I had a good lip in my days. Good lip. I could blow all night, go blow. I blew three days and three nights. What was that? I played all night at the boss's place and go to the camp and play all day for Al Capone. For Al Capone, Al Capone was furnishing my boss with all that liquor. When he was looking for Al Capone in Chicago, Al Capone was right here. Down here. In my place, that's my place where I was playing…
was the name of it? Do you remember? Any special name on it or just the boss's name? Oh, it
